text:
I’m live rn until I catch my first Shiny Pokémon (1 in 8,192 odds)

For every Pokémon encounter, we’re adding $1 to a pool (currently at $84)… Someone watching is going to get all the money in the pool when I catch Shiny Onix, tune in rn on YouTube & Twitch
